mentions.name: lspwatch
mentions.description: A telemetry-capturing proxy for the Language Server Protocol (LSP) that makes instrumenting language servers easy. Support for MCP (Model Context Protocol) is being added, with the proxy positioned as a general platform for monitoring or debugging MCP servers or clients.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on supporting MCP (model context protocol) in my LSP (language server protocol) proxy: https://github.com/noredeen/lspwatch.

I wrote this tool to make instrumenting language servers very easy.
